crossRefs.note: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.
“So let all your enemies perish, Yahweh, but let those who love him be as the sun when it rises in its strength.” Then…
So Midian was subdued before the children of Israel, and they lifted up their heads no more. The land had rest forty…
So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that Yahweh spoke to Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance to…
as the days in which the Jews had rest from their enemies, and the month which was turned to them from sorrow to…
When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even…
Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.

people.name: Kenaz
people.line: Father of Othniel, a judge of Israel

people.name: Othniel
people.line: First judge of Israel, Caleb's nephew

translations.web: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
translations.bsb: So the land had rest for forty years, until Othniel son of Kenaz died.
translations.kjv: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
translations.asv: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
